# JABRIX AI

> JABRIX AI (formerly NourAI) is a local-first multilingual autonomous AI platform supporting Arabic, English, and French, offering a native Pre-LN Transformer neural model, autonomous research & project management, 4-tier memory, knowledge graph, sandboxed tools, and Control Center 2.0.

JABRIX AI runs as a progressive web application with an Arabic-first RTL interface, English/French LTR support, and a full local autonomous agent runtime.

## Core Resources

- [JABRIX AI Web App](https://ypyai-95ca7.web.app/): Main interactive AI assistant interface.
- [Control Center 2.0](/control-center): Autonomous agent monitor, research workspace, project manager, memory browser, and approval queue.
- [AI Catalog](https://ypyai-95ca7.web.app/ai-catalog.json): Machine-readable JSON catalog describing JABRIX AI capabilities and resources.
- [Web App Manifest](https://ypyai-95ca7.web.app/manifest.json): Progressive Web App metadata.
- [Sitemap](https://ypyai-95ca7.web.app/sitemap.xml): XML sitemap for search engines.

## Capabilities

- [General Chat](https://ypyai-95ca7.web.app/): Direct Q&A and structured explanations in Arabic, English, and French.
- [Autonomous Agent & Research](/control-center): Multi-step planning, DAG tool orchestration, citation-traceable research, and persistent project management.
